name: Hopper WGMMA 64x128x16 FP16 with FP32 accumulation
summary: Use a Hopper warpgroup MMA atom with shared-memory A and B operands to compute a 64x128x16 FP16 matrix product into FP32 accumulators.

strategy.intent: Maximize Tensor Core throughput for FP16 GEMM on Hopper.
strategy.mechanism: Issue an asynchronous warpgroup MMA whose A and B operands are described in shared memory and whose accumulator fragments remain in registers.
strategy.expected_benefit: Maps the inner GEMM computation to Hopper Tensor Cores with warpgroup-level execution.
tradeoffs: Requires SM90a architecture features and valid shared-memory descriptors.

parameters.name: scale_a
parameters.description: Input scaling mode for operand A.

parameters.name: scale_b
parameters.description: Input scaling mode for operand B.

parameters.name: scale_d
parameters.description: Whether existing accumulator values participate in the operation.

constraints.rationale: The wrapper guards the instruction with CUTE_ARCH_MMA_SM90A_ENABLED.

constraints.expression: A == fp16 && B == fp16 && accumulator == fp32
constraints.rationale: The selected atom encodes F32F16F16 operand types.
The hardware atom has a fixed instruction shape.
The SS form consumes shared-memory descriptors for both operands.

references.evidence: The atom declares its register types and emits the SM90a WGMMA instruction for the fixed M, N, and K shape.
